preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of the array is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases won't exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases is at most 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a rearranged array of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] <= output[i+1] for i in range(len(output)-1)) or all(output[i] >= output[i+1] for i in range(len(output)-1)) for output in outputs
postconditions.description: The rearranged array is either entirely non-increasing or non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: no subarray of length greater than 2 is non-increasing or non-decreasing
postconditions.description: No subarray of length greater than 2 in the original or rearranged array is non-increasing or non-decreasing.
